sloka: इदम् द्वितीयम् दुर्धर्षम् विष्णोर् दत्तम् सुरोत्तमैः ।तत् इदम् वैष्णवम् राम धनुः पर पुरम् जयम् ॥१-७५-१३॥
transliteration: idam dvitīyam durdharṣam viṣṇor dattam surottamaiḥ ।tat idam vaiṣṇavam rāma dhanuḥ para puram jayam ॥1-75-13॥

translations.english: This second bow which is unassailable was given by chief of the celestials to Visnu. O Rama born in the race of Kakutstha this highly radiant bow of Visnu is as strong as the bow of Siva.
